trigger.user_observation: supervisor activity was durable but not mirrored to the invoking terminal

change.description: Wrap each supervised Prompt-16 operation in the repository's existing ResearchLogSession and request 30-second supervisor heartbeats. Human INFO/ACTIVE/DONE/STOP lines are mirrored to the same terminal while durable human, JSONL audit, debug, supervisor-summary, resource-sample, and checkpoint logs remain enabled.
change.selector_stage_labeling: method-specific component labels are supplied for selection heartbeats
change.evaluation_stage_labeling: method/model-specific component labels are supplied for model-fit/evaluation heartbeats

checks: human heartbeat includes UTC timestamp, ACTIVE status, detailed stage, elapsed time, process-tree RAM, and available RAM
existing process-safe research logging tests remain compatible

restart_semantics.matrix: immutable completed matrix is authenticated and reused; it is not rebuilt
restart_semantics.pilot: fold-1 data loading restarts because the controlled stop occurred before any selector/evaluation checkpoint
restart_semantics.selector_and_evaluation_resume: future sealed exact-identity selector/evaluation checkpoints are reused
restart_semantics.resource_guard: unchanged hard abort at 24 GiB process-tree RSS or 8 GiB system-available RAM
restart_semantics.recommendation: close memory-heavy applications and restore at least approximately 24 GiB available RAM before restarting; do not lower the frozen floor
